issue.title: Recipes - View Recipe
issue.description:
## 💡 User Story
As a user,
I want to view a recipe,
so that I can get more info about the recipe.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Any user (visitor, contributor, admin) can view a published recipe page
- [ ] The recipe page displays: title, description, duration, difficulty, ingredients, steps, image(s)
- [ ] The recipe page displays the nutritional details table per serving
- [ ] While nutritional data is still being fetched, a loading indicator is shown in the nutritional details table
- [ ] If no nutritional data is available, a fallback message is shown in the nutritional details table
- [ ] A serving size selector is available that scales ingredient quantities accordingly

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
### Backend
- GET /recipes/:id
- If recipe is not found, return 404
- Return all recipe fields: title, description, duration, difficulty, ingredients, steps, image(s)
- Return the associated nutritional details table data per serving alongside the recipe

### Frontend
- On page load, fetch the recipe data from the API and render all fields
- Edit/delete buttons are conditionally rendered based on user.id === recipe.owner_id or user.role === admin
- Recipe details are clear and visible on the page, based on the [mockup](url)
- A clear zone showing nutritional details per serving is visible
- A serving size selector scales ingredient quantities 1x (default), 2x, 4x

logs.description: Created the view recipe related backend and frontend elements (route, controller/service/repo functions, frontend routes) etc.
logs.reflection: Ran into issues with the user images. I'm not sure how I can handle serving images from my backend to the client via the frontend.
